# GitLab MCP

Connect the tools exposed by a GitLab MCP server. Enter your instance’s HTTPS origin. The server must enable GitLab’s MCP feature and support HTTP transport, introduced in GitLab 18.6.

For OAuth, register a confidential application on that instance with the callback shown by the connection form and the `mcp` scope. Enter its client credentials when connecting. The shared GitLab REST client is not eligible for this scope.

Alternatively use a fine-grained personal access token with MCP tool Execute permission. Legacy personal, project and group tokens are not supported by GitLab’s MCP server. Every tool call requires approval because server tool annotations are not an authorization boundary.

The REST GitLab app remains available independently. This app does not enable the server feature or change instance settings.
